title: dalechampia linearis var. goyazensis
intro: Dalechampia linearis var. goyazensis, commonly known as the "Goyaz milk flower," is a plant species in the Euphorbiaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Brazil, due to its reported health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Goyaz milk flower are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiviral activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
